docs.title: About
docs.text:
I’m a Data Science / Data Engineering-focused student based in Germany. I enjoy building practical data products—pipelines, analytics layers, and ML workflows—with a focus on performance and sustainability.

Current interests: Spark/Databricks • Azure/AWS • ML pipelines • Data Engineering • Software Engineering

docs.title: Full Stack Engineering Senior Analyst (Data Engineering – Azure/Databricks) (Bengaluru, India)
docs.text:
Oct 29, 2020 – Oct 07, 2023 • Full-time (45 hrs/week) - Created and maintained Azure Data Factory pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from multiple sources into the Azure data platform. :contentReference[oaicite:4]{index=4} - Collaborated with cross-functional teams to design and implement data solutions aligned with business requirements. :contentReference[oaicite:5]{index=5} - Worked in an Agile (Scrum) environment to manage deliverables and releases. :contentReference[oaicite:6]{index=6} - Designed and developed a metadata management solution using Azure Functions + SQL Database to maintain data catalog information for organizational data assets. :contentReference[oaicite:7]{index=7} - Improved ADF logging performance using asynchronous activity to reduce data processing time and improve system performance. :contentReference[oaicite:8]{index=8} - Enhanced Databricks PySpark transformations by adding features to improve processing efficiency and support new business requirements. :contentReference[oaicite:9]{index=9} - Built a prototype “Data Marketplace” publishing workflow using Power Apps + Power Automate + Azure Functions, including automated approvals, metadata configuration, and triggered data-load pipelines. :contentReference[oaicite:10]{index=10} - Developed a Power BI report to visualize Azure cost consumption across teams within the project. :contentReference[oaicite:11]{index=11} - Tested and debugged end-to-end ETL pipelines to ensure reliable processing and delivery to target systems. :contentReference[oaicite:12]{index=12}

Tools/Skills (from role): Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse), Azure Data Factory, Python, PySpark, Azure Synapse Analytics, Databricks, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Purview, Azure SQL, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Azure DevOps, Git, ADLS Gen2, Log Analytics + KQL, Azure OpenAI, and more. :contentReference[oaicite:13]{index=13} Reference: Reference letter (PDF)
